title: Why Contagious Yawns Prove You Have Empathy
caption:
Caught a yawn just by watching one? That's not tiredness.
On the subway, a guy who feels 100% energized catches a stranger's yawn within seconds, then the whole car starts yawning too.
Key fact: mirror neurons make yawns contagious, and catching one is linked to empathy - proof your brain relates to others, not that you need sleep.
Be honest: did you just yawn while watching this?
Share this with the friend who yawns first every time.
